description: On This Week in Connecticut, Dennis House hears from two Democrats, Cinzia Lettieri and Rob Blanchard, seeking elected office in the General Assembly. Hear their reasons for running and why they believe the party needs to "step up.”
paid_for_by: Paid for by Lettieri for State Rep, Treasurer Seth Kweller
title: Democratic candidates running for Connecticut General Assembly say the party needs to 'step up' — Cinzia Lettieri For State Representative
